Hi! I'm Maxine and I'm originally from Calgary, AB. I completed my BSc in Cognitive Systems and a Minor in Data Science at UBC. Before starting this program, I was a 2025 DSSG Fellow at the UBC Data Science Institute and  working as an HRIS Data Analyst at MNP. Through the UBC MDS program, I hope to deepen my technical skills and build a more holistic understanding of the field as I work toward becoming a Data Scientist.
